name: Photo Booth
description: A party photo booth on your phone: a countdown, four shots in a row and a printed style strip or grid, in colour, black and white, retro or pop.
prompt: A photo booth with the front camera: a 3 2 1 countdown, four shots with a flash, colour, black and white, retro or pop looks, and a strip or grid with the date to save.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Un fotomatón de fiesta en tu móvil: cuenta atrás, cuatro fotos seguidas y una tira o cuadrícula como impresa, en color, blanco y negro, retro o pop.
